scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @sanjeevani/web && npm run build --workspace @sanjeevani/functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build --workspace @sanjeevani/web && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build --workspace @sanjeevani/web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build --workspace @sanjeevani/functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sanjeevani --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/verify-emulator.mjs"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build --workspace @sanjeevani/web
